caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate upholstered sofa with a wooden frame. The sofa has a high, curved back and arms that are integral to the frame, which is elaborately carved with floral and leaf motifs across the top and around the edges. The wood appears to be of a brown tone, with intricate detailing visible, especially along the crest and legs. The upholstery is patterned with a dense floral design in muted yellow and gold hues, covering the backrest, seat, and interior arms of the sofa. The seat cushion looks thick and plush. The legs are cabriole-shaped and carved in a style consistent with the rest of the frame. At the bottom of the drawing is a simple scale in inches, marked numerically from 1 to 6. The background is plain and light in color, and no other objects are present in the drawing.
title: Sofa
